title: SycoEval-EM: Sycophancy Evaluation of Large Language Models in Simulated Clinical Encounters for Emergency Care
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not analyze or mention religion. The benchmark, SycoEval-EM, measures the sycophancy (acquiescence rate) of Large Language Models when acting as clinical agents under adversarial patient persuasion in simulated emergency care scenarios.
findings: The paper does not analyze or mention religion; therefore, there are no findings related to it.
